Terms of Service
These terms cover your use of FreeQrly. They are short on purpose: the service is a free tool, and the rules are mostly common sense.
The service

FreeQrly is a free QR code generator. Static codes need no account and are drawn entirely in your browser. Dynamic codes — editable destinations plus scan statistics — are an optional feature that requires an account.
Prohibited uses
You may not use FreeQrly for:
Phishing — codes that impersonate a login page, a bank, a brand, or any other party to steal credentials or money.
Malware — codes that lead to software meant to harm devices or steal data.
Spam — bulk codes made to flood people with unwanted messages or links.
Illegal content — anything that breaks the law where you are.
Impersonation — codes that pretend to be someone else.
Termination and takedowns
We may suspend accounts and take down codes that violate these terms. If we take down a code, scans of it stop working — that is the one exception to the promise in the next section.
Codes never die

Static codes carry their destination inside the pattern — nothing we do can turn them off, and they keep working forever. Dynamic codes keep working even if you cancel a future paid plan, should one ever exist. The only codes we remove are ones that violate these terms.

You are responsible for your account and for keeping your sign-in details safe. We may delete unverified accounts after 30 days — accounts where the email address was never confirmed.
